metadata.description: Claude Code skills by Vipul Chauhan.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit
plugins.description: Skills for building new products. Includes a design system builder that turns a brief, screenshots, or a brand palette into design tokens, light and dark themes, component specs, and a WCAG contrast report, a project planner that splits a spec into phases for a coding agent, a doc trimmer that cuts hedging, filler, and repeated ideas from text, files, or URLs, a doc reviewer that attacks a design doc, spec, or writeup and reports only the holes, ranked by severity, and a UI developer that builds or restyles frontend UI from a design system's tokens with no custom CSS, using Base UI for behavior and accessibility.
